headline: Feds Struggle to Prove Murder for Hire in Lil Durk Case
body: Trap Lore Ross claims federal authorities will have difficulty proving murder-for-hire charges against Lil Durk, though stalking allegations remain a significant issue. The post, published September 11, 2026, highlights the legal complexities surrounding the rapper's ongoing trial. Ross, known for his deep coverage of hip-hop legal drama, emphasizes the challenges of proving intent in high-stakes cases.
